title: Hearty Crisp Portuguese Casabe Paella
description: A macrobiotic friendly one pot dish featuring casabe, this recipe combines the best of Portuguese flavors with a crispy twist, all while utilizing a bain marie for even cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large oven safe skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced portuguese sausage and cook until it is browned.
Add the crushed casabe, sea salt, black pepper, and paprika, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the skillet with foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
